# LegatorOCR v0.2.0-pre.46 (pre-release)

One bug found by a tester in pre.45 (pre.45 can be skipped). Written and tried by the author's assistant on one Linux machine; the automated tests pass on CI runners. **Nothing was tried by hand on Windows, macOS or arm64, and the fix was not tried on the tester's photo in the window.**

**Fixed**
- **Picture zones were dropped on a page with its own keystone.** On a page that had a trapezoid correction of its own (Auto keystone, or the page's trapezoid sliders), the zones drawn with the "Image" and "No image" pencils on the original were thrown away, so in Mixed mode the pictures of that page came out as black-and-white halftone like the text. The zones now follow the page through the correction and keep their place. A test covers it (right page Mixed, with its own keystone and a picture zone).

**Verified**: fmt, clippy `-D warnings`, the core tests. **Not verified**: the tester's page in the window; Windows, macOS, arm64. On the macOS Intel runner (experimental) two PKCS#12 tests fail because of its OpenSSL, unrelated.
